يؤتنس (form VIII)
# يُؤْتَنَسُ (yuʔtanasu) /juʔ.ta.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# يُؤْتَنَسَ (yuʔtanasa) /juʔ.ta.na.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# يُؤْتَنَسْ (yuʔtanas) /juʔ.ta.nas/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
